name: RAD BOMBARDMENT
text: Once per battle, as a strategic gambit from the second turning point: pick an objective marker or the enemy drop zone. Each enemy in control range of that marker, or with any part of its base in that drop zone, rolls a D6 (minus 1 if any part of its base is under Vantage terrain). On 4+ it has 1 less APL until the end of its next activation; on a 6 it also takes D3 damage.

name: REDUNDANCY SYSTEMS
text: Once per turning point, as a friendly Hunter Clade operative is activated outside an enemy control range, it may regain up to D3+2 lost wounds.

name: REFRACTOR FIELD
text: Once per turning point, when a friendly Hunter Clade operative is shot, just before defence dice are rolled: the x of the attack's Piercing is 1 lower for that sequence, so Piercing 1 disappears.

name: EXTREMIS MIND-LINK
text: Once per battle, CONTROL EDICT costs 0 CP, and the two operatives are activated together instead of one after the other: you perform their actions one at a time in any order until both are done.
